reason:
Updated HAL_UARTEx_ReceiveToIdle to prevent calling HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback. The function now:
1. Never calls HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback
2. Just returns HAL_OK when data is received successfully
3. This is consistent with other changes to avoid HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback
4. Prevents any potential loops from this function
